title: Rotate Image
goal: Solve Rotate Image: Rotate a square matrix in place by moving each position to its quarter-turn destination while preserving values needed by later moves.
strategy: Rotate a square matrix in place by moving each position to its quarter-turn destination while preserving values needed by later moves.
edgeCases: The center of an odd-sized matrix stays fixed; each four-position cycle must avoid overwriting an unread value.
inputRules: matrix must be a non-empty array of rows
matrix must be square (n x n)
